subject: Coord: Security walkthrough — compressed two-block option for FinTechCo
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fintechco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Security walkthrough — proposal for compressed two-block session

Hi Liam,

Thanks again for picking Redwood for the evaluation — really looking forward to the walkthrough. To keep things efficient for your team we had an idea: instead of one long block, split the session into two focused blocks on the same day (technical deep-dive + evidence handoff / controls Q&A). That helps us limit the number of participants needed per block and gives your ops team a clear handoff point.

Proposed slots (all times in CET / convertors below):
- Block A (Technical deep-dive & pen vendor sync): 2028-03-22 09:00-10:30 CET
- Block B (Controls, SOC 2 evidence & legal/DPA questions): 2028-03-22 13:00-14:00 CET

If that date doesn't work, we can move to 2028-03-24 with the same blocks. We can also compress Block A to 60 minutes if you prefer.

Attachments: placeholder SOC2 questionnaire we use to pre-populate (FinTechCo_SOC2_Questionnaire_v1.pdf) and our network diagram for pen vendor context.

Quick ask: can you confirm (a) whether your pen vendor needs separate credentials for the pen window, and (b) whether legal wants the DPA questions in Block B or as a separate micro-session?

I'll let Ben jump in on the pen-run logistics — Ben, any notes on credentials or vendor intake to share?

Cheers,
Diego
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
attachments: [FinTechCo_SOC2_Questionnaire_v1.pdf, redwood-network-diagram.png]

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fintechco.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: security@fintechco.com
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 14:08:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Security walkthrough — proposal for compressed two-block session

Diego — thanks, this looks sensible. A couple of quick notes from our side:

- Pen vendor (AcmePenTest) will need short-lived credentials for the penetration window. We can create a scoped user if you provide required ACLs.
- Legal would prefer DPA questions ahead of time (we can review the checklist asynchronously) but will still join Block B for any clarifications.

3 quick asks:
1) Can you add a 15-minute buffer after Block A to let our ops reset sessions?
2) Can you capture a short list of the artifacts you'll hand off so we can pre-stage them?
3) We need the calendar invites in CET; we are UTC+0 (UK team) but our SOC team is CET so align to CET please.

I'll loop in AcmePenTest ops once we lock the date.

— Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Security, FinTechCo
liam.oconnor@fintechco.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fintechco.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 14:25:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Security walkthrough — proposal for compressed two-block session

Thanks Liam — quick answers from the pen logistics side:

- Short-lived creds: yes, we can issue timeboxed credentials scoped to the pen vendor. We'll need the vendor's public key and an IP allowlist window (if you have one).
- Buffer: +15 minutes after Block A makes sense.

Planned artifacts we'll hand off during the session (pre-stage request):
- Service architecture diagram (redwood-network-diagram.png)
- KV cache and routing config excerpts (sanitized)
- Tokenization and rate-limits summary (csv excerpt)
- Evidence index (evidence-index.csv) for SOC 2 controls mapping

I'll prepare the credentials playbook and the vendor intake doc and share before the call. Rachel, I'll need a short list of any extra evidence the SOC reviewers will want up front.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Security Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fintechco.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 15:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Security walkthrough — proposal for compressed two-block session

Ben / Diego — attaching the SOC 2 questionnaire I've started mapping to our evidence index so FinTechCo can see what we'll present during Block B. I've added comments where we expect FinTechCo to confirm retention windows and data residency.

Attachment: FinTechCo_SOC2_Questionnaire_v1.pdf (annotated)
Also attaching evidence-index.csv that maps control IDs to folder paths.

Note for FinTechCo: if you can pre-share any endpoint allowlist preferences and the pen vendor public key (or the vendor contact we should call), we'll take care of the scoped creds.

— Rachel
Rachel Kim
Head of Compliance Programs, Redwood Inference
attachments: [FinTechCo_SOC2_Questionnaire_v1.pdf, evidence-index.csv]

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fintechco.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Mar 2028 09:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Security walkthrough — proposal for compressed two-block session

Thanks team — confirmed on our side. We can do 2028-03-22 CET with the 15-minute buffer. Our vendor point of contact is Aoife Murphy (aoife.murphy@acmepen.com). I'll ask AcmePenTest to provide their public key and expected IP ranges by Monday.

We've asked legal to review the questionnaire asynchronously and I'll post any DPA asks to the shared Drive link you provided.

Also: sending a DocuSign envelope for the non-disclosure addendum — please sign so we can share detailed configs with AcmePenTest. Link: https://app.docusign.com/FinTechCo/ENVELOPE-9931

— Liam

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fintechco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Mar 2028 15:33:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Security walkthrough — proposal for compressed two-block session

Perfect — thanks Liam. I'll send calendar invites aligned to CET now (both blocks + 15-minute buffer between them).

What I'll attach to the invite:
- Hand-off checklist (PDF)
- Redacted network diagram (redwood-network-diagram.png)
- Evidence index (evidence-index.csv)

Action items tracked:
- AcmePenTest to share public key & IP ranges (Liam)
- FinTechCo legal to scan questionnaire and post DPA asks (Liam)
- Redwood to prepare vendor creds playbook (Ben) and pre-stage artifacts in Drive (Rachel)

If anything changes I'll flag here. Looking forward to the session — will set up a short internal run-through with our ops on 2028-03-20.

Best,
Diego
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
attachments: [hand-off-checklist.pdf]
